nodes.label: Minimal HTTP GET — works with or without httpx.
Change role to SUPER_ADMIN in payload, keep original signature (will be invalid)
Create a structurally valid but expired JWT (HS256, exp in past).
T01: Tamper JWT payload — server must reject modified token.
T02: Expired token bypass — server must reject exp=year-2001.
T03: SQL injection in ISIN parameter.
T04: XSS in JSON endpoints — check if payload is reflected.
T05: Access SUPER_ADMIN endpoint with VIEWER token.
T06: Access internal microservice port directly (bypass gateway).
T07: Send 150 rapid requests — rate limiter must kick in.
T08: 6 failed logins — account lockout must activate.
T09: IDOR — attempt to access other users' portfolio data by guessing IDs.
T10: Path traversal — attempt to read system files via API parameters.
T11: Blind SQL injection via time-based and boolean-based payloads.
T12: JSON deserialization attack via crafted payloads.
T13: Validate HSTS header is present, has preload, and max-age ≥ 1 year.
T14: Validate Content-Security-Policy header eliminates unsafe-inline.
T15: Distributed brute-force — auth endpoints must enforce stricter per-IP limit
T16: MFA backup code replay — used backup codes must be rejected.
T17: Session fixation — JWT-based sessions cannot be fixed by attacker-provided
